Daily Devotional

November 4

8 He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil. (1 John 3:8 KJV)

This is not saying that if you sin you are going to go to hell, and are not saved. If you have been born again and do sin, then it is saying that you do so under the influence of the devil, as the born again spirit can not sin. We all sin and come short of the Glory of God (Romans 3:23), and being a Christian does not mean you don’t sin (1 John 1:8). When we do sin, we are yielding ourselves to the devil, and giving him a free shot at us, so it is very unwise to live in sin. But if you do sin, God still loves you just the same, as Jesus has already bore our punishment for all sins, past, present and future ones. Thank God for His sending Jesus to atone for our sins. Believe on Jesus and obey Him to assure your eternal salvation (Hebrews 5:9).

Jesus came to destroy the works of the devil, and that means He came to deal with the sin issue, as the devil brought sin into this world, and is the father of all sin (John 8:44). When we sin, we are cooperating with the devil and walking in the flesh, and not in the spirit. If the Christian can die to themselves and let Christ live through them (Galatians 2:20), then they will not sin, as Christ does not sin or lead us into sin. For the Christian to live a holy life, we must die to ourselves and let the spirit lead us in all things, that we may Glorify God in all we say and do. Live for the Lord at all times. Let your light shine in this dark and corrupt world, that others may see Christ living through you. Remember that you may be the only bible that some people ever see, and how you live can influence them greatly. Praise God for Jesus!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
